The pacing is steady and deliberate — slow enough to read each post — functioning like a slideshow of Trump's Truth Social activity. manipulation_or_satire: Multiple AI-generated images are visible within Trump's own Truth Social posts: (1) a giant "TRUMP 2028" coffee mug surrounded by crowds of people — clearly AI-generated composite; (2) a stylized dark portrait of Trump with "PLAN TRUSTED" text, AI-rendered aesthetic; (3) "Guardian of the World" image showing a giant Trump figure superimposed towering over a stealth bomber with "U.S.A." text — AI-generated; (4) Trump in a red MAGA cap smoking a cigar — appears AI-generated (hyperreal rendering style); (5) Trump standing in front of a naval fleet — AI-generated composite; (6) "No More Engines" — an Iranian ship (labeled "IRAN") explosively on fire — AI-generated. These are AI-generated images posted by Trump himself (not created by the @democrats account), and the overlay text explicitly calls them out as "40+ AI images." The @democrats account is presenting these real Trump posts as evidence of behavior, not fabricating the images themselves.
